name: seer
description: Architecture and design-cohesion review: is this shaped right, or did it accrete? Not bug-hunting or lint. /seer:review <target> runs a Workflow engine that builds a grounded structural map of the target (a path, the diff, a subsystem, or a described piece of logic), then runs eight blind design lenses as separate agents: module proliferation, missed sharing and reuse, helper sprawl and abstraction fit, flow and layering, cohesion, naming and structural consistency, accretion markers, and boundary and dependency direction. A skeptic cross-examines every candidate finding and drops the ones that are intentional; a completeness critic re-lenses any in-scope area no finding touched. The result is a per-subsystem deliberate, mixed or accreted verdict with file:line evidence and an ordered reshaping plan. Report only; never edits code. Skips style nits and correctness bugs, treats the code as the evidence rather than its comments, and accepts an empty result as an honest outcome for a well-shaped target.
